description: Complete CreateScreen (Upload Artwork) premium composition redesign - 3:4 portrait hero ratio, refined thumbnail strip, hashtag keyword placeholder, lighter Content Declaration, and overall spacing/typography polish
steps: 1. Modify the heroTouchable style in mobile/src/screens/create/CreateScreen.tsx: Change from height-based sizing (Math.min(SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.28, 240)) to a proper 3:4 PORTRAIT ratio container. Use width as the reference: heroTouchable width should be approximately SCREEN_WIDTH - 24 (with 12px content padding on each side), and height should be (SCREEN_WIDTH - 24) * (4/3) capped at a reasonable maximum like Math.min((SCREEN_WIDTH - 24) * 1.1, SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.42) to avoid overly tall containers on large devices. The key requirement: the container MUST be taller than it is wide (portrait, not square). Add elegant rounded corners (borderRadius 20), soft shadow (shadowOpacity 0.1, shadowRadius 12).

2. Update the thumbnail strip styling: Increase thumbnail size from 52x52 to 60x60. Increase gap from 6 to 10. Make selected state more pronounced (borderWidth 2.5, add inner glow effect via shadow). Adjust thumbnailRemoveBtn to be positioned at top: -5, right: -5 with slightly smaller size (18x18). Improve the 'Add' button to match 60x60 with matching borderRadius 12.
3. Change the keywords/tags placeholder text from 'landscape, oil painting, Nepal' to '# Add keywords separated by commas'. Keep the helper text below as-is.

4. Reduce Content Declaration section typography: (a) complianceTitleText fontSize from 14 to 13, fontWeight from '700' to '600'. (b) complianceLabel fontSize stays at 12 but fontWeight changes from '600' to '500'. (c) complianceHelper fontSize stays at 11. (d) Checkbox icon size from 24 to 20. (e) Info icon stays at 14 but ensure it is vertically centered with the row. (f) Overall complianceCard padding from 10 to 12, the section should feel informative rather than visually heavy.

5. Improve overall spacing consistency: (a) heroContainer marginBottom from 4 to 10. (b) paginationDots marginBottom from 4 to 8. (c) thumbnailStrip marginBottom from 8 to 12. (d) fieldContainer marginBottom from 10 to 14. (e) Reduce heroPlaceholderTitle fontSize from 16 to 15. (f) Reduce heroPlaceholderSubtitle to show 'Up to 5 images + 1 video | JPG, PNG, WEBP, MP4 | Max 10MB/image, 50MB/video' as the subtitle.
6. Preserve ALL existing functionality: media picking, form state, publish flow, guest restrictions, animation logic, navigation, API calls. Only visual/layout changes.
acceptance_criteria: CreateScreen renders without syntax/runtime errors (valid TSX)
Hero preview container has portrait (3:4 or similar) aspect ratio - height > width
Thumbnail strip items are 60x60 with improved spacing
Keywords placeholder reads '# Add keywords separated by commas'
Content Declaration typography is lighter (smaller title, lighter label weight)
All existing upload, media picking, and form submission functionality preserved
verification: Read the modified CreateScreen.tsx and confirm all imports resolve to existing modules
Verify heroTouchable height calculation produces a portrait (taller than wide) container
Check that placeholder text is exactly '# Add keywords separated by commas'
Verify no new dependencies are imported
findings: All changes implemented successfully. Hero height formula Math.min((SCREEN_WIDTH - 24) * 1.2, SCREEN_HEIGHT * 0.45) produces portrait ratio on all common screen sizes (e.g. 393px width -> ~443px height, clearly taller than wide). Thumbnails increased to 60x60 with gap 10. Keywords placeholder exact match. Content Declaration typography lightened. Bracket balance verified via node script (0/0/0). No new imports added. All existing functionality preserved - only style properties and placeholder text changed.
